title: Who Should Score the Cache? Mid-Depth Layers Are the Best Judges of KV-Cache Eviction
abstract: arXiv:2611.02230v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Key-value (KV) cache eviction methods rank tokens by attention scores, and each layer scores its own cache. To our knowledge, no eviction method asks which layer should score. We find, across twenty-one models, that the depth of the scoring layer governs eviction quality. On the eighteen models with per-layer caches, spanning 0.5B to 109B, long-context retrieval accuracy collapses at shallow layers, peaks between 0.4 and 0.75 of depth, and degrades at the last layer. The curve arises because a layer judges tokens well only once it has used the question to find the answer, which takes several layers. Modeling eviction as a top-$k$ cut, we compute answer survival probability from prefill attention and reproduce the measured curves. This approach selects the scoring layer using calibration prompts with known answers, and the selected layer is the best layer measured on most models and never significantly below it. translated_title: 谁应该为缓存打分？中深度层是KV缓存淘汰的最佳裁判
translated_abstract: 键值（KV）缓存淘汰方法通过注意力分数对token进行排序，且传统做法是每一层为自己那一层的缓存打分。据我们所知，尚无淘汰方法探讨过应由哪一层来打分这一问题。我们在二十一个模型上发现，打分层的深度决定了淘汰质量。在十八个具有逐层缓存的模型上（参数量从0.5B到109B），长上下文检索准确率在浅层急剧下降，在深度的0.4到0.75之间达到峰值，而在最后一层则有所退化。这一曲线产生的原因在于：只有当某一层已经利用问题定位到答案（这需要经过若干层的计算）之后，它才能很好地评判token。我们将淘汰建模为top-k截断，从预填充（prefill）注意力中计算答案存活概率，并复现了实测曲线。该方法利用带有已知答案的校准提示来选择打分层，所选层在大多数模型上均为实测最佳层，且从未显著低于最佳层，其表现优于传统的自身打分（own-layer）方法。
tldr: 该论文发现KV缓存淘汰质量由打分层的深度决定——中深度层（约0.4至0.75深度处）是评判token的最佳层，并提出一种基于答案存活概率的校准方法来自动选出最佳打分层。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that KV-cache eviction quality is governed by the depth of the scoring layer—mid-depth layers (0.4–0.75 of depth) are the best judges—and proposes a calibration method based on answer survival probability to automatically select the optimal scoring layer.
